$comment: Hard marginal gzip budgets in KiB for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative application shell in $baseline; only the entry and its transitively static chunks count as initial, while dynamic first-open chunks remain in the separate total-cost budgets. Ceilings resolve to positive whole-byte limits and retain at most 4% drift. The 2026-09-16 review remeasured the menu route after the current shared slot-collection and menu-item compatibility surfaces were present: it measured 10,272 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 10,478 bytes (2% headroom). The 2026-09-17 review remeasured the combobox route after its new sync property: it measured 29,850 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 30,447 bytes (2% headroom). The 2026-09-18 review remeasured the export-button route after its compact size and appearance options: it measured 8,826 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 9,004 bytes (2% headroom). Other ceilings retain their previously reviewed measurements. The 2026-09-23 review for the 20.0.0 major remeasured seven routes whose initial chunk grew with that release's remediation (settled-closed popups removed from layout, shared overlay-stack Escape registration for floating previews, voice-picker catalog icons and menu name stability): tool-call-chip 5793 -> ceiling 5908; voice-picker 17635 -> ceiling 17987; menu 10674 -> ceiling 10887; citation-badge 4785 -> ceiling 4880; entity-chip 4270 -> ceiling 4355; export-button 9323 -> ceiling 9509; mention-popover 5703 -> ceiling 5817 bytes (2% headroom). Other ceilings retain their previously reviewed measurements. The 2026-09-25 review remeasured the popover route after the shared floating-surface edge gained its decorative/control tier chain (panels on the decorative border tier, form-associated popups pinned to the control tier): it measured 13,328 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 13,595 bytes (2% headroom). Other ceilings retain their previously reviewed measurements. The 2026-09-25 review for the 21.0.0 wave-1b integration remeasured the select route after the shared overlay-stack focus-handoff and rel-guard changes: it measured 24,442 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 24,930 bytes (2% headroom). Other ceilings retain their previously reviewed measurements. The 2026-09-25 review for the 21.0.0 shadcn programme wave integration (toggle, toggle-group, navigation-menu, context-menu, tool-call-block, and the shared overlay focus-handoff/rel-guard changes) remeasured the model-select route: it measured 16,001 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 16,321 bytes (2% headroom).
